title: Hit-stop and big-kill slow motion as the player (A/B)
intro: Fighter, Warrior or Thief main pawn is best (melee hits). Start as the Arisen. Press End to start.

steps.text: AS THE ARISEN (reference): kill these goblins with heavy hits. Feel the little freeze on each hit.
steps.each_frame:
if not G_hs then
  G_hs = { n = 0, sum = 0, max = 0, by = {} }
  local wr = sdk.find_type_definition("app.WorkRate")
  local m = wr and wr:get_method("setHitStop(System.Single, System.Single, System.Boolean)")
  if m then
    sdk.hook(m, function(args)
      local ok, t = pcall(sdk.to_float, args[3])
      if ok and type(t) == "number" then
        G_hs.n = G_hs.n + 1; G_hs.sum = G_hs.sum + t; if t > G_hs.max then G_hs.max = t end
        local k = G_stage or "?"
        local b = G_hs.by[k] or { n = 0, sum = 0 }
        b.n = b.n + 1; b.sum = b.sum + t; G_hs.by[k] = b
      end
    end, function(r) return r end)
  end
end
